description: Feedback2Me Observability V3 — CENTRAL SLO/threshold contract. The runtime evaluator (ops/monitor/evaluate-runtime.mjs) is the ONLY consumer; no thresholds are hardcoded in scripts. Tuned for LOW-TRAFFIC: rate alarms require a minimum sample AND an absolute-count floor so a 1/1 blip never pages. Money-safety invariants are CRITICAL regardless of sample size. All values are conservative starting points — adjust with evidence, not guesswork.

window.note: Evaluation window over ops-status/runtime-events/*.jsonl. Kept modest for low-traffic + low Cloud Logging cost.

collector.note: Scheduled collector runs ~every 30 min. 95 min tolerance = ~3 missed runs before COLLECTOR_STALE CRITICAL (avoids paging on one late run). NO_OBSERVABILITY (auth/collector failure) is distinct from NO_TRAFFIC.

moneySafety.note: Any invariant breach (verify-success-without-credit, granted!=+1, replay!=+0, credit-on-unknown-product, credit-on-failure, duplicate-grant-per-correlation) is CRITICAL + releaseBlocking immediately, regardless of sample size.

tokenSpike.note: avg total tokens/request above this = possible prompt/response explosion (WARNING only)

railway.note: 0 requests = NO_TRAFFIC (HEALTHY/IDLE), NOT failure. RAILWAY_UNREACHABLE (collector could not reach Railway) is distinct and WARNING (release-informational).

postgres.note: Direct low-privilege health probe. One failed probe = WARNING; 3 consecutive = CRITICAL.

releaseGate.note: Real IAP E2E is a DEFERRED VALIDATION (IAP_E2E_VALIDATION_DEFERRED = WARN, non-blocking at the current TestFlight stage) — tracked in ops/validation-requirements.json (requiredForProductRelease=true, requiredForObservabilityPlatform=false). It keeps runtimeValidationStatus PARTIAL but does NOT block observabilityPlatformStatus=FULL. Only real runtime CRITICALs (money-safety, verify-down, postgres-critical, collector-stale, secret-leak) BLOCK. A public/production-release policy that requires real E2E would re-add it to blockOn for that gate.

notification.note: Only NEW CRITICAL alerts warrant a proactive incident notification. WARNING = artifact/report only. INFO = nothing. ONGOING never re-notifies except per criticalRenotifyMinutes; RESOLVED emits exactly one resolution update.

incidentDelivery.note: Cooldown/flapping guards so a service alternating HEALTHY/UNHEALTHY never spams. criticalRenotifyMinutes: force a keep-alive comment on an ONGOING critical at most this often. incidentUpdateCooldownMinutes: minimum spacing between material-change updates (matches the 30-min monitoring cadence — at most one update per cycle). resolvedStabilityMinutes: an incident must be clear this long before it is RESOLVED (auto-close). flappingWindowMinutes/flappingMinTransitions: >= this many NEW+RESOLVE transitions within the window marks the incident FLAPPING (one held-open incident, no per-cycle spam). maxIncidentUpdatesPerHour: hard cap on issue comments per incident. Real writes require OPS_INCIDENT_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true (default false); OPS_ALERT_DRY_RUN=true computes actions without any GitHub write.

trend.note: Low-traffic-safe: a metric needs >= minSampleForTrend on BOTH sides to trend; deltas smaller than the pct thresholds are STABLE; missing baseline = INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Never trend on 1-2 sample noise.
